title: Marketing orchestration with Typeface, built for the Gemini era
markdown:
STRATEGIC PARTNER

## Marketing orchestration, built for the Gemini era

[Get a demo](https://www.typeface.ai/get-a-demo)

Bring Google’s latest AI into connected marketing workflows with Typeface. Access brand and audience context from [Arc Graph](https://www.typeface.ai/product/brand-hub), create assets with [Arc Agents](https://www.typeface.ai/product/arc-agents), and activate across Google Ads, Performance Max, and CM360.

KEY FEATURES

## Work natively with Typeface    inside Google

TYPEFACE MCP

## Run full marketing workflows directly in Gemini

Teams can go from ideation to activation in their Google native workflow with Typeface. Inside Gemini, teams can invoke Typeface to bring in brand and audience context, generate assets across formats, and launch to Google channels without any manual handoffs.

[Learn more](https://www.typeface.ai/mcp)

![image-partner-google-typeface-MCP-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/4DIeAMTtCeisZAAvoGuchn/37def024aaa49b51daa445186961ad27/image-partner-google-typeface-MCP-468x468.png)

AD AGENT

## Create campaign ready ads faster across every format

Typeface turns a single idea into campaign ready ads for YouTube, display, and more. Teams can generate image and video ads from a prompt, edit with transcript-based workflows, resize for placements, and produce audience specific variations faster without relying on design bottlenecks.

[Learn more](https://www.typeface.ai/product/ad-agent)

![image-partner-google-ad-agent-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/plfnj5dKJkBiANm6XIjTH/c4816eb21aa51f123ce6159792016532/image-partner-google-ad-agent-468x468.png)

GOOGLE MODELS

## Create with Google’s best-in-class AI models

Use Google’s latest models across the full content lifecycle. From Gemini and Imagen 3 to Veo and Nano, Typeface helps teams create, adapt, and scale campaign-ready assets with brand control built in.

![image-partner-google-models-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/6K5ySQRCSEupLHVPdD5vHb/fcffcf32f5be25951632fc1c2548dce5/image-partner-google-models-468x468.png)

INTEGRATIONS

## Launch across Google from a connected system

Typeface connects creation to activation across Google Ads, Performance Max, and CM360, so teams can move from approved assets to live campaigns faster, with connected workflows, fewer handoffs, and more consistent execution.

![image-partner-google-integrations-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/1ApvG0xx2mcYel8AXj8ZPz/58e82023e35600b18222c8ae55d0d711/image-partner-google-integrations-468x468.png)

Arc Fabric

## Built for governed, scalable agentic systems

Arc Fabric lets teams customize Typeface to their exact workflows and use cases. By turning complex processes into governed, repeatable systems, it helps scale AI adoption across the organization.

[Learn more](https://www.typeface.ai/product/arc-fabric)

![image-partner-google-arc-forge-468x468](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/5T9vTWOPlKtZOA7Jplexv0/edf5062841df14d5559db1c99cd4fe84/image-partner-google-arc-forge-468x468.png)

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/5JGHer7pdCuSlD0fi2YLtu/f7d811b835962b5245144fd10c77aefd/image-partner-google-quote-background.png)

WHAT OUR PARTNERS ARE SAYING

“Enterprises need their data and AI systems to work together seamlessly. Our collaboration with Typeface helps bring brand-aware campaign personalization into Google Cloud’s marketingarchitecture.”

![image-partner-google-quote-logo-bnw](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/7qGskND9qt328Oryr7mcdJ/641f1e3495a7d369aee6134fe71dd154/image-partner-google-quote-logo-bnw.svg)

Head of Marketing

Google Cloud
